This book is designed to empower you with knowledge on how to utilize plants for various ailments, including:
*   Headaches
*   Colds and Flu
*   Insomnia
*   Burns
*   Cuts and Wounds

More than just a collection of plants, this guide provides actionable recipes and instructions for practical self-care. You will discover detailed methods for preparing:
